text.body:
॥ śivānandalaharī ॥
kalābhyāṃ cūḍālaṅkṛtaśaśikalābhyāṃ nijatapaḥphalābhyāṃ bhakteṣu prakaṭitaphalābhyāṃ bhavatu me । śivābhyāmastokatribhuvana śivābhyāṃ hṛdi punarbhavābhyāmānandasphuradanubhavābhyāṃ natiriyam ॥1 galantī śambho tvaccaritasaritaḥ kilbiṣarajo dalantī dhīkulyāsaraṇiṣu patantī vijayatām । diśantī saṃsārabhramaṇaparitāpopaśamanaṃ vasantī maccetohradabhuvi śivānandalaharī ॥2 trayīvedyaṃ hṛdyaṃ tripuraharamādyaṃ trinayanaṃ jaṭābhārodāraṃ caladuragahāraṃ mṛgadharam । mahādevaṃ devaṃ mayi sadayabhāvaṃ paśupatiṃ dālambaṃ sāmbaṃ śivamativiḍambaṃ hṛdi bhaje ॥3 hasraṃ vartante jagati vibudhāḥ kṣudraphaladāḥ na madhye svapne vā tadanusaraṇaṃ tatkṛtaphalam । haribrahmādīnāmapi nikaṭabhājāmasulabhaṃ ciraṃ yāce śambho śiva śiva tavāmbhojabhajanam ॥ smṛtau śāstre vaidye śakunakavitāgānaphaṇitau purāṇe mantre vā stutinaṭanahāsyeṣvacaturaḥ । kathaṃ rājñāṃ prītirbhavati mayi ko'haṃ paśupate paśuṃ māṃ sarvajña prathitakṛpayā pālaya vibho ॥5 ghaṭo vā mṛtpiṇḍo'pyaṇurapi ca dhūmo'gniracalaḥ paṭo vā tanturvā pariharati kiṃ ghoraśamanam । vṛthā kaṇṭhakṣobhaṃ vahasi tarasā tarkavacasā padāmbhojaṃ śambhorbhaja paramasaukhyaṃ vraja sudhīḥ ॥6 manaste pādābje nivasatu vacaḥ stotraphaṇitī karau cābhyarcāyāṃ śrutirapi kathākarṇanavidhau tava dhyāne buddhirnayanayugalaṃ mūrtivibhave parapranthānkairvā paramaśiva jāne paramataḥ ॥7 yathā buddhiḥ śuktau rajatamiti kācāśmani maṇirjale paiṣṭe kṣīraṃ bhavati mṛgatuṣṇāsu salilam । tathādevabhrāntyā bhajati bhavadanyaṃ jaḍajano mahādeveśaṃ tvāṃ manasi ca na matvā paśupate ॥ 8 gabhīre kāsāre viṃśati vijane ghoravipine viśāle śaile ca bhramati kusumārthaṃ jaḍamatiḥ । samarpyaikaṃ cetaḥ sarasijamumānātha bhavate sukhenāvasthātuṃ jana iha najānāti kimaho । 9 naratvaṃ devatvaṃ nagavanamṛgatvaṃ maśakatā paśutvaṃ kīṭatvaṃ bhavatu vihagatvātijananam । sadā tvatpādābjasmaraṇaparamānandalaharīvihārāsaktaṃ ceddhṛdayamiha kiṃ tena vapuṣā ॥10 vaṭurvā gehī vā yatirapi jaṭī vā taditaro naro vā yaḥ kaścidbhavatu bhava kiṃ tena bhavati । yadīyaṃ hṛtpadmaṃ yadi bhavadadhīnaṃ paśupate tadīyastvaṃ śambho bhavasi bhavabhāraṃ ca vahasi ॥ 11 guhāyāṃ gehe vā bahirapi vane vā'driśikhare jale vā vahrau vā vasatu vasateḥ kiṃ vada phalam । sadā yasyaivāntaḥkaraṇamapi śambho tava pade śvitaṃ cedyogo'sau sa ca paramayogī sa ca sukhī ॥ asāre saṃsāre nijabhajanadūre jaḍadhiyā bhramantaṃ māmandhaṃ paramakṛtayā pātumucitam । madanyaḥ ko dīnastava kṛpaṇarakṣātinipuṇassvadanyaḥ ko vā metrijagati śaraṇyaḥ paśupate॥ prabhustvaṃ dīnānāṃ khalu paramabandhuḥ paśupate pramukhyo'haṃ teṣāmapi kimuta bandhutvamanayoḥ । tvayaiva kṣantavyāḥ śiva madaparādhāśca sakalāḥ prayatnātkartavyaṃ madavanamiyaṃ bandhusaraṇiḥ ॥14 upekṣā no cetkiṃ harasi bhavaddhyānavimukhāṃ durāśābhūyiṣṭhāṃ vidhilipimaśakto yadi bhavān । śirastadvaidhātraṃ na na khalu suvṛttaṃ paśupate kā vā niryatnaṃ karanakhamukhenaiva lulitam ॥ 15 viriñcirdīrghāyubhavatu bhavatā tatparaśiraścatuṣkaṃ saṃrakṣyaṃ sa khalu bhuvi dainyaṃ likhitavān । vicāraḥ ko vā māṃ viśadakṛpayā pāti śiva te kaṭākṣavyāpāraḥ svayamapi ca dīnāvanaparaḥ॥ 16 phalādvā puṇyānāṃ mayi karuṇayā vā svayi vimo prasanne'pi svāmin bhavadamalapādābjayugalam । kathaṃ paśyeyaṃ māṃ sthagayati namaḥ sambhramajuṣāṃ nilimpānāṃ śreṇirnijakanakamāṇikyamakuṭaiḥ॥ 17 tvameko lokānāṃ paramaphalado divyapadavī vahantastvanmūlāṃ punarapi bhajante harimukhāḥ।। kiyadvā dākṣiṇyaṃ tava śiva madāśā ca kiyatī kadā vā madrakṣāṃ vahasi karuṇāpūritadṛśā 18 durāśābhūyiṣṭhe du?dhipagṛhadvāraghaṭake durante saṃsāre duritālaye dukhijanake । madāyāsaṃ kiṃ na vyapanayāsna kasyopakṛtaye vadeyaṃ prītiścettava śiva kṛtārthāḥ khalu vayam ॥19 sadā mohāṭavyāṃ carati yuvatīnāṃ kucagirau naṭatyāśāśākhāsvaṭāti jhaṭiti svairamabhitaḥ। kapālin bhikṣo me hṛdayakapimatyantacapalaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhaktyā baddhvā śiva bhavadhīnaṃ kuru vibho ॥20 dhṛtistambhādhārāṃ guṇanivaddhāṃ sagamanāṃ vicitrāṃ padmāḍhyāṃ pratidivasasanmārgaghaṭitām । smarāre maccetaḥ sphuṭapaṭakuṭīṃ prāpya viśadāṃ jaya svāmin śaktyā saha śiva gaṇaiḥ sevita vibho।। pralobhādyairarthāharaṇaparatantro dhanigṛhe praveśodyuktaḥ sambhramati bahudhā taskarapate । imaṃ cetaścoraṃ kathamiha sahe śaṅkara vibho tavādhīnaṃ kṛtvā mayi niraparādhe kuru kṛpām ॥ 22 karomi tvatpūjāṃ sapadi sukhado me bhava vibho vidhitvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ diśasi khalu tasyāḥ phalamiti। punaśca tvā draṣṭuṃ divi bhuvi vahanpanimṛgatā madṛṣṭvā tatkhedaṃ kathamiha sahe śaṅkara vibho ॥ 23 kadā vā kailāse kanakamaṇisaudhe saha gaṇaivasañchambhoragre sphuṭaghaṭitamūrdhāñjalipuṭaḥ। vibho sāmba khāminparamaśiva pāhīti nigadanvidhātṝṇāṃ kalpānkṣaṇamiva vineṣyāmi sukhataḥ ॥ stavairbrahmādīnāṃ jayajayavacobhirniyamanāṃ gaṇānāṃ kelībhirmadakalamahokṣasya kakudi । sthitaṃ nīlagrīvaṃ trinayanamumāśliṣṭhavapuṣaṃ kadā tvāṃ paśyeyaṃ karadhṛtamṛgaṃ khaṇḍaparaśum ॥25 kadā vā tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā giriśa tava bhavyāṅghriyurālaṃ gṛhītvā hastābhyāṃ śirasi nayane vakṣasi vahan । samāśliṣyāghrāya sphuṭajalajagandhānparimalānalābhyāṃ brahmādhairmudamanubhaviṣyāmi hṛdaye ॥ 26 karasthe hemādrau giriśa nikaṭasthe dhanapatau gṛhasthe svarbhūjāmarasurabhicintāmaṇigaṇe। śiraḥsthe śītāṃṣau caraṇayugalasthe'khilaśubhe kamarthaṃ dāsye'haṃ bhavatu bhavadarthaṃ mama manaḥ ? ॥ sārūpyaṃ tava pūjane śiva mahādeveti saṅkīrtane sāmīpyaṃ śivabhaktidhuryajanatāsāṅgatyasambhāṣaṇe । sālokyaṃ ca carācarātmakatanudhyāne bhavānīpate sāyujyaṃ mama siddhamatra bhavati svāminkṛtārtho'smyaham ॥ 28 tvatpādāmbujamarcayāmi paramaṃ tvāṃ cintayāmyanvahaṃ tvāmīśaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi vacasā tvāmeva yāce vibho। vīkṣāṃ me diśa cākṣuṣīṃ sakaruṇāṃ divyaiściraṃ prārthitāṃ śambho lokaguro madīyamanasaḥ saukhyopadeśaṃ kuru ॥ vasrodbhūtavidhau sahasrakaratā puṣpārcane viṣṇu । gandhe gandhavahātmatā'nnapacane barhirmukhādhyakṣatā । pātre kāñcanagarbhatā'sti mayi cedbālenducūḍāmaṇe śuśrūṣāṃ karavāṇi te paśupate svāmitrilokīguro ॥ nālaṃ vā paramopakārakamidaṃ tvekaṃ paśūnāṃ pate paśyankukṣigatāṃśvarācaragaṇānbāhyasthitānnakṣitum । sarvāmartyapalāyanauṣadhamatijvālākaraṃ bhīkaraṃ nikṣiptaṃ garalaṃ galena gilitaṃ nodgīrṇameva tvayā ॥ jvālograḥ sakalāmarātibhayadaḥ kṣvelaḥ kathaṃ vā tvayā duṣṭaḥ kiṃ ca kare dhṛtaḥ karavale kiṃ pakkajambūphalam । jihvāyāṃ nihitaśca siddhavuṭikā vā kaṇṭhadeśe bhṛtaḥ kiṃ te nīlamaṇirvibhūṣaṇamayaṃ śambho mahātmanvada ॥ nālaṃ vā sakṛdeva deva bhavataḥ sevā natirvā nutiḥ pūjā vā smaraṇaṃ kathāśravaṇamapyālokanaṃ mādṛśām । svāminnasthiradevatānusaraṇāyāsena kiṃ labhyate kā vā muktiritaḥ kuto bhavati cetkiṃ prārthanīyaṃ tadā॥ kiṃ brūmastava sāhasaṃ paśupate kasyāsti śambho bhavaddhairyaṃ cedṛśamātmanaḥ sthitiriyaṃ cānyaiḥ kathaṃ labhyate । bhraśyadevagaṇaṃ trasanmunigaṇaṃ naśyatprapañcaṃ layaṃ paśyanirbhaya eka eva viharatyānandasāndro bhavān ।। yogakṣemadhurandharastha sakalaśreyaḥpradodyogino dṛṣṭādṛṣṭamatopadeśakṛtino bāhyāntaravyāpinaḥ । sarvajñasya dayākarasya bhavataḥ kiṃ veditavyaṃ mayā śambho tvaṃ paramāntaraṅga iti me cittesmarāmyanvaham॥ bhakto bhaktiguṇāvṛte mudamṛtāpūrṇe prasanne manaḥ kumbhe sāmba tavāṅghripalla yugaṃ saṃsthāpya saṃvitphalam । sattvaṃ mantramudīrayannijaśarīrāgāraśuddhiṃ vahanpuṇyāhaṃ prakaṭīkaromi ruciraṃ kalyāṇamāpādayan ॥ āmnāyāmbudhimādareṇa sumanaḥsaṅghāḥ samudyanmanomanthānaṃ dṛḍhabhaktirajjusahitaṃ kṛtvā mathitvā tataḥ । somaṃ kalpatarūṃ suparvasurabhiṃ cintāmaṇiṃ dhīmatāṃ nityānandasudhāṃ nirantararamāsaubhāgyamātanvate ॥37 prākpuṇyācalamārgadarśitasudhāmūrtiḥ prasannaḥśivaḥ somaḥ sadgaṇasevito mṛgadharaḥ pūrṇastamomocakaḥ । cetaḥ puṣkaralakṣito bhavati cedānandapāyonidhiḥ prākalbhyena vijṛmbhate sumanasāṃ vṛttistadā jāyate॥ dharmo me caturaṅghrikaḥ sucaritaḥ pāpaṃ vināśaṃ gataṃ kāmakrodhamadādayovigalitāḥ kālāḥ sukhāviṣkṛtā। jñānānandamahauṣadhiḥ suphalitā kaivalyanāthe sadā mānye mānasapuṇḍarīkanagare rājāvataṃse sthite ॥ 39 dhīyantreṇa vacoghaṭena kavitākulyopakulyākramairānītaśca sadāśivasya caritāmbhorāśidivyāmṛtaiḥ । hṛtkedārayutāśca bhāktikalamāḥ sāphalyamātanvate durbhikṣānmama sevakasya bhagavanviśveśa bhītiḥ kutaḥ॥ pāpotpātavimocanāya ruciraiśvaryāya mṛtyuñjayastotradhyānanatipradakṣiṇasaparyālokanākarṇane jihvācittaśiroṅghrihastanayanaśrotrairahaṃ prārthito māmājñāpaya tannirūpaya muhurmāmeva mā me'vacaḥ ॥ gāmbhīryaṃ parikhāpadaṃ ghanadhṛtiḥ prākāra udyadguṇastomaścāptabalaṃ dhanendriyacayo dvārāṇi dehe sthitaḥ । vidyā vastusamṛddhirityakhilasāmagrīsamete sadā durgātipriyadeva māmakamanodurge nivāsaṃ kuru ॥ 42 mā gaccha tvamitastato giriśa bho mayyeva vāsaṃ kuru svāminnādikirāta māmakamanaḥkāntārasīmāntare। vartante bahuśo mṛgā madajuṣo mātsaryamohādayastānhatvā mṛgayāvinodarucitālābhaṃ ca samprāpsyasi॥ karalagnamṛgaḥ karīndrabhaṅgo ghanaśārdūlavikhaṇḍanosta jantuḥ । giriśo viśadākṛtiśca cetaḥkuhare pañcamukho'ntime kuto bhīḥ ॥44 chandaḥśākhiśikhānvitairdvijavaraiḥ saṃsevite śāśvate saukhyāpādini khedabhedini sudhāsāraiḥ phalairdipite । cetaḥpakṣiśikhāmaṇe tyaja vṛthāsañcāramanyairalaṃ nityaṃ śaṅkarapādapadmayugalīnīḍe vihāraṃ kuru ॥45 ākīrṇe nakharājikāntivibhavairudyatsudhāvaibhavairādhaute'pi ca padmarāgalalite haṃsavrajairāśrite। nityaṃ bhaktivadhūgaṇaiśca rahasi svecchāvihāraṃ kuru sthitvā mānasarājahaṃsa girijānāthāṅghrisaudhāntare ॥ śambhudhyānavasantasaṅgini hṛdārāme'ghajīrṇacchadāḥ srastā bhaktilatācchaṭāvilasitāḥ puṇyapravālaśritāḥ। dīpyante guṇakorakā japavacaḥpuṣpāṇi sadvāsanā jñānānandasudhāmarandalaharī saṃvitphalābhyunnatiḥ॥47 nityānandarasālayaṃ suramunisvāntāmbujātāśrayaṃ svacchaṃ sadvऱijasevitaṃ kaluṣahṛtsadvāsanāviṣkṛtam । śambhudhyānasarovaraṃ vraja manohaṃsāvataṃsa sthiraṃ kiṃ kṣudrāśrayapalvalabhramaṇasañjātaśramaṃ prāpsyasi ॥48 ānandāmṛtapūritā harapadāmbhojālavālodyatā sthairyopaghnamupetya bhaktilatikā śākhopaśākhānvitā । uccairmānasakāyamānapaṭalīmākramya niṣkalmaṣā nityābhīṣṭaphalapradā bhavatu me satkarmasaṃvardhitā ॥ 41 sandhyārambhāvijṛmbhitaṃ śrutiśiraḥsthānāntarādhiṣṭhitaṃ sapremabhramarābhirāmamasakṛtsadvāsanāśobhitam । bhogīndrābharaṇaṃ samastasumanaḥ pūjyaṃ guṇāviṣkṛtaṃ seve śrīgirimāllikārjunamahāliṅgaṃ śivāliṅgitam ॥ śṛṅgīcchānaṭanotkaṭaḥ karimadagrāhī sphuranmādhavāhlādo nādayuto mahāsitavapuḥ pañceṣuṇā cādṛtaḥ । satpakṣaḥ sumanovaneṣu sa punaḥ sālānmadīye manorājīve bhramarādhipo viharatāṃ śrīśailavāsī vibhuḥ॥ kāruṇyāmṛtavarṣiṇaṃ ghanavipadgrīṣmacchidākarmaṭhaṃ vidyāsasyaphalodayāya sumanaḥ saṃsevyamicchākṛtim । nṛtyadbhaktamayūramadrinilayaṃ cañcajjaṭāmaṇḍalaṃ śambho vāñchati nīlakandhara sadā tvāṃ me manaścātakaḥ॥ ākāśena śikhī samastaphaṇināṃ netrā kalāpī natānupāhipraṇavopadeśaninadaiḥ kekīti yo gīyate । śyāmāṃ śailasamudbhavāṃ dhanaruciṃ dṛṣṭvā naṭantaṃ mudā vedāntopavane vihārarasike taṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ bhaje ॥ 53 sandhyādharmadinātyayo harikarāghātaprabhūtānakadhvāno vāridagarjitaṃ diviṣadāṃ dṛṣṭicchaṭā cañcalā। bhaktānāṃ paritoṣabāṣpavitatirvṛṣṭirmayūrī śivā yasminnujjvalatāṇḍavaṃ vijayate taṃ nīlamaṇṭhaṃ bhaje ॥ ādyāyāmitatejase śrutipadairvedyāya sādhyāya te vidyānandamayātmane vijagataḥ saṃrakṣaṇodyogine dhyeyāyākhilayogibhiḥ suragaṇairgeyāya māyāvine samyaktāṇḍavasambhramāya jaṭine seyaṃ natiḥ śambhave ॥ nityāya triguṇātmane purajite kātyāyanīśreyase satyāyādikuṭumbine munimanaḥpratyakṣacinmūrtaye । māyāsṛṣṭajagattrayāya sakalāmnāyāntasañcāriṇe sāyaṃtāṇḍavasambhramāya jaṭine seyaṃ na śambhave ॥56 nityaṃ svodarapūraṇāya sakalānuddiśya vittāśayā vyarthaṃ paryaṭanaṃ karomi bhavataḥ sevāṃ na jāne vibho। majjanmāntarapuṇyapākabalatastvaṃ śarva sarvāntarastiṣṭhasyeva hi tena vā paśupate te rakṣaṇīyo'smyaham ॥ eko vārijabāndhavaḥ kṣitinabhovyāptaṃ tamomaṇḍalaṃ bhittvā locanagocaro'pi bhavati tvaṃ koṭisūryaprabhaḥ। vedyaḥ kiṃ na bhavasyaho ghanataraṃ kīdṛgbhavenmattamastatsarvaṃ vyapanīya me paśupate sākṣātprasanno bhava॥ haṃsaḥ pagmavanaṃ samicchati yadā nīlāmbudaṃ cātakaḥ kokaḥ kokanadapriyaṃ pratidinaṃ candraṃ cakorastathā। ceto vāñchati māmakaṃ paśupate cinmārgamṛgyaṃ vibho gaurīnātha bhavatpadābjayugalaṃ kaivalyasaukhyapradam ॥ rodhastoyahṛtaḥ śrameṇa paṃthikaśchāyāṃ tarorvṛṣṭito bhītaḥ svasthagṛhaṃ gṛhasthamatithirdīnaḥ prabhu dhārmikam । dīpaṃ santamasākulaśca śikhinaṃ śīsāvṛtastvaṃ tathā cetaḥ sarvabhayāpahaṃ vraja sukhaṃ śambhoḥ padāmbhoruham ॥ akkolaṃ nijabījasantatirayaskāntopalaṃ sūcikā sādhvī naijavibhuṃ latā kṣitiruhaṃ sindhuḥ saridvallabham । prāpnotīha yathā tathā paśupateḥ pādāravindadvayaṃ cetovṛttirupetya tiṣṭhati sadā sā bhaktirityucyate ॥ ānandāśrubhirātanoti pulakaṃ nairmalyataścchādanaṃ vācāśaṅkhamukhe sthiteśca jaṭharāpūrtiṃ caritrāmṛtaiḥ । rudrākṣairbhasitena deva vapuṣo rakṣāṃ bhavadbhāvanā paryaṅke viniveśya bhaktijananī bhaktārbhakaṃ rakṣati ॥ mārgāvartitapādukā paśupateraṅgasya kūrvāyate gaṇḍūṣāmbuniṣecanaṃ puraripordivyābhiṣekāyate । kiṃcidbhakṣitamāṃsaśeṣakabalaṃ navyopahārāyate bhaktiḥ kiṃ na karotyaho vanacaro bhaktāvataṃsāyate॥ vakṣastāḍanamantakasya kaṭhināpasmārasammardanaṃ bhūbhṛtparyaṭanaṃ namatsuraśiraḥkoṭīrasaṅgharṣaṇam । karmedaṃ mṛdulasya tāvakapadadvandvasya kiṃ vocitaṃ maccetomaṇipādukāviharaṇaṃ śambho sadāṅgī kuru ॥ vakṣastāḍanaśaṅkayā vicalito vaivasvato nirjarāḥ koṭīrojjvalaratnadīpakalikānīrājanaṃ kurvate । dṛṣṭvā muktivadhūstanoti nibhṛtāśleṣaṃ bhavānīpate yaccetastava pādapadmabhajanaṃ tasyeha kiṃ durlabham ॥ 65 krīḍārthaṃ sṛjati prapañcamakhilaṃ krīḍāmṛgāste janāḥ matkarmācaritaṃ mayā ca bhavataḥ prītyai bhavatyeva tat । śambho svasya kutūhalasya
